game_title: Integration Heist – Buried Temple Steps Rush
game_concept: A arcade set in Sand Dunes – Buried Temple Steps, steps of a half-buried temple: the camel trader must handle sandstorms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Integration Heist: Combine loops, conditionals, and lists to complete a multi-step script that raids Buried Temple Steps.
theme: Sand Dunes – Buried Temple Steps: steps of a half-buried temple
core_gameplay_loop: In Buried Temple Steps, repeat each round: Combine loops, conditionals, and lists to complete a multi-step script that raids Buried Temple Steps. Each round, a new sun cloaks challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the heist value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 180 points of sun cloaks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 180, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 2 (intro tier): Integration Heist
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Integration Heist' (Week 9 slot 7), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Buried Temple Steps'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how heist changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sandstorms in Buried Temple Steps.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 180 within 26 seconds.
